title: 庭院之下的地图
summary: A hand-drawn map found during courtyard repairs leads residents on a journey to uncover their neighborhood's shared history and ignite communal renewal.
topic: A hand-drawn map found during courtyard repairs

blocks.hanzi: 老城区的一座院落年久失修，居民们决定集资翻新。施工队挖开青砖地面时，发现了一个锈迹斑斑的铁盒。
blocks.translation: An old compound in the old city district had been dilapidated for years, so the residents decided to pool money to renovate it. When the construction team dug up the blue brick ground, they found a rusty iron box.
blocks.pinyin: Lǎo chéng qū de yī zuò yuàn luò nián jiǔ shī xiū, jū mín men jué dìng jí zī fān xīn. Shī gōng duì wā kāi qīng zhuān dì miàn shí, fā xiàn le yī gè xiù jì bān bān de tiě hé.

blocks.hanzi: 盒子里是一张泛黄的油纸，上面用炭笔勾勒着复杂的线条，标注着一些已经消失的地名。
blocks.translation: Inside was a yellowed sheet of oiled paper, with complex lines sketched in charcoal and labels for places that no longer existed.
blocks.pinyin: hé zi lǐ shì yī zhāng fàn huáng de yóu zhǐ ， shàng miàn yòng tàn bǐ gōu lè zhe fù zá de xiàn tiáo ， biāo zhù zhe yī xiē yǐ jīng xiāo shī de dì míng 。

blocks.translation: Could this be a treasure map?
blocks.pinyin: zhè nán dào shì yī zhāng cáng bǎo tú?

blocks.hanzi: 哪里有什么宝藏，我小时候听老人说，这院子底下埋着一段往事。
blocks.translation: Treasure? No such thing. When I was young, I heard the elders say that a piece of history lay buried beneath this courtyard.
blocks.pinyin: nǎ lǐ yǒu shén me bǎo zàng, wǒ xiǎo shí hou tīng lǎo rén shuō, zhè yuàn zi dǐ xià mái zhe yī duàn wǎng shì.

blocks.hanzi: 李伟是社区里最热心的年轻人，他提议按图索骥，寻找线索。陈奶奶颤巍巍地指着地图上一个圆圈标记。
blocks.translation: Li Wei was the community's most enthusiastic young resident. He suggested following the map in search of clues. Grandma Chen pointed with a trembling hand to a circle marked on it.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi shì shèqū lǐ zuì rèxīn de niánqīngrén, tā tíyì àntúsuǒjì, xúnzhǎo xiànsuǒ. Chén nǎinai chànwēiwēi de zhǐzhe dìtú shàng yīgè yuánquān biāojì.

tokens.gloss: follow the map to find the horse (idiom: look for clues systematically)

blocks.hanzi: 这个圈是古井的位置，我小时候井还在，后来填平了。
blocks.translation: This circle is the location of the ancient well. When I was a child, the well was still there, and later it was filled in.
blocks.pinyin: zhè ge quān shì gǔ jǐng de wèi zhì, wǒ xiǎo shí hou jǐng hái zài, hòu lái tián píng le.

blocks.hanzi: 居民们合力挖开古井的位置，泥土下露出一个陶罐，里面装着褪色的照片和泛黄的信件。
blocks.translation: The residents worked together to excavate the old well site. Beneath the soil they uncovered a clay jar containing faded photographs and yellowed letters.
blocks.pinyin: jū mín men hé lì wā kāi gǔ jǐng de wèi zhì, ní tǔ xià lù chū yī gè táo guàn, lǐ miàn zhuāng zhe tuì sè de zhào piàn hé fàn huáng de xìn jiàn.

blocks.hanzi: 照片上是一群衣着朴素的年轻人，站在院落里微笑，后面挂着一条横幅，写着“第一建筑队留念”。
blocks.translation: The photograph showed a group of plainly dressed young people smiling in the courtyard. Behind them hung a banner reading, 'First Construction Team—In Commemoration.'
blocks.pinyin: zhào piàn shàng shì yī qún yī zhuó pǔ sù de nián qīng rén ， zhàn zài yuàn luò lǐ wēi xiào ， hòu miàn guà zhe yī tiáo héng fú ， xiě zhe “ dì yī jiàn zhù duì liú niàn ” 。

blocks.hanzi: 我认得！这是我父亲那辈人，他们从各地来，一起建起了这片街区。
blocks.translation: I recognize them! They're from my father's generation. They came from all over and built this neighborhood together.
blocks.pinyin: wǒ rèn de! zhè shì wǒ fù qīn nà bèi rén, tā men cóng gè dì lái, yī qǐ jiàn qǐ le zhè piàn jiē qū.

blocks.hanzi: 信件里记录着他们的辛酸与希望，其中一封信写道：“咱们的院子就是家，哪天要是拆了，就把这些埋在地下，让后人记住。”
blocks.translation: The letters record their bitterness and hope. One of the letters reads: "Our yard is home. If one day it is demolished, bury these underground so that future generations remember."
blocks.pinyin: xìnjiàn lǐ jìlù zhe tāmen de xīnsuān yǔ xīwàng ， qízhōng yī fēng xìn xiědào ： “ zánmen de yuànzi jiùshì jiā ， nǎtiān yàoshì chāi le ， jiù bǎ zhèxiē mái zài dìxià ， ràng hòurén jìzhù 。 ”

blocks.hanzi: 李伟深受触动，他召集居民开会，大家一致决定不找什么宝藏，而是修复院落，将这段历史展示出来。
blocks.translation: Li Wei was deeply moved. He called a meeting of the residents, and everyone unanimously decided not to look for any treasure, but to restore the courtyard and display this history.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi shēn shòu chù dòng, tā zhào jí jū mín kāi huì, dà jiā yī zhì jué dìng bù zhǎo shén me bǎo zàng, ér shì xiū fù yuàn luò, jiāng zhè duàn lì shǐ zhǎn shì chū lái.

blocks.hanzi: 这比任何金银财宝都珍贵。我们把这院子改成社区纪念馆，让邻里都知道我们脚下的土地曾经是什么。
blocks.translation: This is more precious than any gold or silver. Let's turn the courtyard into a community museum so everyone in the neighborhood can learn what the ground beneath our feet once held.
blocks.pinyin: Zhè bǐ rènhé jīnyín cáibǎo dōu zhēnguì. Wǒmen bǎ zhè yuànzi gǎichéng shèqū jìniànguǎn, ràng línlǐ dōu zhīdào wǒmen jiǎoxià de tǔdì céngjīng shì shénme.

blocks.hanzi: 三个月后，院落焕然一新。青砖墙上嵌着玻璃展柜，陈列着陶罐里的照片和信件。古井原址上立了一块石碑，镌刻着所有建设者的名字。
blocks.translation: Three months later, the courtyard had been transformed. Glass cases set into the blue-brick walls displayed the photographs and letters from the clay jar. A stone monument stood on the old well site, engraved with the builders' names.
blocks.pinyin: sān gè yuè hòu, yuàn luò huàn rán yī xīn. qīng zhuān qiáng shàng qiàn zhe bō li zhǎn guì, chén liè zhe táo guàn lǐ de zhào piàn hé xìn jiàn. gǔ jǐng yuán zhǐ shàng lì le yī kuài shí bēi, juān kè zhe suǒ yǒu jiàn shè zhě de míng zì.

tokens.gloss: take on an entirely new look

blocks.hanzi: 居民们经常在院子里聚会，孩子们在石碑旁玩耍。那张古老的地图被装裱起来，挂在入口处，提醒着每一个人：这里埋藏的，从来不是金银，而是比金银更重的记忆与归属。
blocks.translation: The residents often gathered in the courtyard while children played beside the monument. The old map was framed and hung at the entrance, reminding everyone that what lay buried there was never gold or silver, but the far weightier treasures of memory and belonging.
blocks.pinyin: jūmínmen jīngcháng zài yuànzi lǐ jùhuì, háizimen zài shíbēi páng wánshuǎ. nà zhāng gǔlǎo de dìtú bèi zhuāngbiǎo qǐlái, guà zài rùkǒu chù, tíxǐng zhe měi yī gè rén: zhèlǐ máicáng de, cónglái búshì jīnyín, érshì bǐ jīnyín gèng zhòng de jìyì yǔ guīshǔ.

blocks.hanzi: 这下好了，院子活了，人也亲了。
blocks.translation: Now that's better—the courtyard has come back to life, and the neighbors have grown closer.
blocks.pinyin: zhè xià hǎo le, yuànzi huó le, rén yě qīn le.

blocks.hanzi: 李伟站在院子里，望着熙攘的人群，感到一种从未有过的踏实。他知道，这张地图指引他们找到的，是根。
blocks.translation: Li Wei stood in the courtyard, watching the bustling crowd, feeling a kind of peace he had never felt before. He knew that what this map guided them to find was their roots.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi zhàn zài yuànzi lǐ, wàng zhe xīrǎng de rénqún, gǎndào yī zhǒng cóngwèi yǒu guò de tāshí. Tā zhīdào, zhè zhāng dìtú zhǐyǐn tāmen zhǎodào de, shì gēn.
